description: Produce a standard-library Python module that renders a JSON array of objects as CSV text, plus pytest tests. Choose this when you need a tested function that renders a JSON array of objects as CSV, using the union of keys as the header. Do not choose this when you need the conversion performed on your data now, or when the CSV format must be bespoke (delimiter, quoting rules). Example requests: Write a Python function that renders a JSON array of objects as CSV, with tests. | I need JSON to CSV with the header being the union of all keys. | Generate a JSON-to-CSV module and prove it with pytest.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

function_name.description: Name of the function the module must define.

module_name.description: Lowercase module name, used for the file name.

template.description: Which registered behaviour to produce. The behaviour is fixed by the template and verified by the template's own tests.
